notes.title: Avatars Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone - we have deployed a new patch for those who have Steam keys to access Samsara for testing purposes. If you wish to play the latest update, you may need to restart Steam for it to pick up the patch.[/p][p]We are happy to share that there are changes to address the feedback regarding the feel and pacing of combat, as well as to tackle some of the other user feedback we received during the Steam Next Fest in June.[/p][p][b]July 2025 - Avatars Update[/b][/p][list][*][p]Unleash unique ultimate powers for all six avatars, powerful abilities that empower you to survive in the deadly world of Kamadhatu.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]New boss at the end of Uttarakuru: battle Mara, "the tempter" and his aspects.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]New boss at the end of Act 2: face the judgement of Yama, "Lord of Death" in your quest to escape Samsara.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Find a mischievous lost Tiryag in an optional questline found in Uttarakuru: End of an Age, who ponders the significance of the bell which tolls doom.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Changes to Combat pacing, animations and feel.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Additional bug fixes and improvements after player feedback.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your continued feedback and bug reports. This update addresses several underlying issues, and we are hard at work on polishing content and fixing said issues. Our team is committed to improving your journey through the Bardo.[/p][p]We believe in transparency, and we want to continue to engage with our players as and when bugs appear. We appreciate your patience as we work to resolve these bugs. Please continue to report any issues you encounter via the in-game link in the Pause menu.[/p][p][/p][p]See you in the Bardo,[/p][p]☸️  Samsara Team[/p]

notes.title: An Important Update on the Release of Samsara
notes.notes: [p]Hello, everyone;[/p][p]We've made the difficult but necessary decision to delay the full launch of Samsara. This means we will not be releasing on Steam tomorrow, June 17th.[/p][p]The feedback we received during Steam Next Fest was incredibly valuable. We saw a lot of interest in the game's core hook: the reincarnation system, where death leads you to one of six avatars based on the karma of your choices. However, you also told us that the impact of your actions on your karma wasn't clear, the initial learning experience was steep and confusing, and the onboarding process needed significant work.[/p][p]Simply put, we agree. Our goal has always been to deliver a challenging but fair souls-like experience, and the current version doesn't properly introduce the very systems that make Samsara unique. Releasing a game that doesn't meet our own standards or your expectations, is not something we're willing to do.[/p][p]For that reason, we are taking this time to go back and focus on key areas. We will be: overhauling the tutorial to better explain core mechanics such as karma, reincarnation and combat; refining and polishing key aspects such as movement, combat and story; as well as implementing quality-of-life fixes and balance tweaks to bring the game up to your exacting standards.[/p][p]This will take time. As such, we don't have a new release date to share right now, as our sole focus is on getting it right.[/p][p]We believe in the vision of Samsara and are committed to realising the game's potential. Thank you for your incredible support and feedback. We'll be keeping you updated on our progress.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]the team @ INFINITY27[/p]

notes.title: The World Cycle Update - Now Live!
notes.notes:
[b]The World Progression Update is now LIVE[/b]

In this update, players will be able to complete the game and experience the full cycle of Samsara.

[list]
[*] Play through the entire Bardo ("intermediate state") after the moment of death: explore acts 1, 2 and 3 of the game in your quest to Escape Samsara - the endless cycle of death and rebirth into which all life is bound.
[*] Explore all four continents of Kamadhatu during Act 1, in pursuit of The Three Jewels. Find yourself thrust into the Heavens and Hells, in an expanded rebirth area, which harbours secret areas only accessible in Act 2. Find a way to Escape Samsara before Act 3, when the 49-day cycle obliterates Kamadhatu and the karmic winds of rebirth drag you into the next life.
[*] New challenge at the end of Aparagodaniya: in pursuit of the enigmatic Kamadhenu, a "wish-granting cow".
[*] Choose to help a mysterious old woman in an optional questline found in Aparagodaniya: A Voice in the Wind, to unravel the secret behind the endless war raging over the wish-granting cow.
[*] Track down a mysterious liquid, a source of powerful visions for the Preta outcast, Raksa: in Resplendent Visions, a new questline in Viratdeha.
[*] Additional bug fixes and improvements after player feedback.
[/list]
[b]Please note[/b]: Save game data will not be compatible with the new version. You will need to enter the settings menu and select to delete save data, else you'll fall through the floor endlessly. 

Gain access to the Early Access version at [url=www.samsaragame.com] samsaragame.com [/url]
Or add to your Wishlist to get the full version once it goes live June 17th!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683570/Samsara/

notes.title: The World Cycle Update

[b]The World Progression Update[/b]

As always we will be running a supervised playtest, if you would like to get involved, please confirm your interest by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/bhJdAQGyAx]Discord[/url] and requesting the [i]Avatar Playtester[/i] role.
This will provide access to the Playtester Guidance posts as they go live before the session.

Let us know your availability and we will pair you up with a developer for live feedback.

notes.title: Release Date and Steam Next Fest Delay
notes.notes:
Dear Samsara Community,

We wish to inform you that we have decided to postpone our participation in the upcoming Steam Next Fest demo. Instead, our focus will now shift to the following fest in [b]June 2025[/b]. Consequently, the 1.0 release of Samsara has been rescheduled for [b]17th June 2025[/b].

This decision has been made to allow us the necessary time to further refine the demo and ensure it reflects the high level of polish that Samsara deserves. To keep you fully informed, our updated release roadmap is available in a previous (now updated) announcement, detailing the upcoming updates—now aligned with the new July end date.

We  are confident that our fans will understand the need for this adjustment. Thank you for your continued support and for holding out just a little longer. Our primary plans remain unchanged, and we are fully committed to making Samsara the best it can be.

Thank you,
the team at INFINITY27

notes.title: Samsara Update Roadmap
notes.notes:
[h2]What is included in the Samsara early access?[/h2]
[b]December 2024[/b] - Early Access release exclusive to the [i]Epic Game Store[/i]

[list]
[*] Three continents to explore within the Desire Realm ("[url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1O8-godtQWFXUcKdvWCDwqYLZNjbBkyNm?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Khamadhatu[/url]"):

[olist]
[*][url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1Z9sAg1buQ8On9cx_BY_pftI5VNVbOKWHQz8fTJgV80I?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Jambudvipa[/url], a tropical continent located south of Mt Meru;
[*][url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1P69oS7hky9BoWQiupuSvkv8tO0cscVxK_4flBrR396A?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Viratdeha[/url], a jewel-encrusted and snow-bound continent to the east;
[*][url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1bXnz74mjIZx61fye_Ot8kmfOjPa4IsN--84UbFhgLbM?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Aparagodaniya[/url], a once lush land that has turned to desert, in the west.
[/olist]
[*] Opening tutorial area, the [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1fggl7cuQpshtWoJP_ldqQzkUdDBOM8TbDhROoYP5qZg?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Rebirth Cave[/url] at the world's edge ("[url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/10bZxu4NLIE8-JVCoL17RbnhTFmDQKaeSpwbU2hZSS1I?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Cakravada[/url]").
[*] Face off against the "Asura Lord of Jambudvipa": [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1LksZ8ytDRzqV5H9QWt86pK3aOR955NMBdXvgGXYBmm4?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Lord Matsala[/url], in a multi-phase boss fight that challenges everything you've learnt.
[*] Engage an optional questline in Jambudvipa that impacts the game world: [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1ACrDd0WRAVXy9L488bSeN1_OVL9Gg7-C5Jkmassn3i4?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Matsala's Folly[/url], featuring the hedonistic and self-righteous Deva, [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1kep97qr2djHN7G_E6ZBeznVrJhw85n79em8eiXhDdO0?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Suvana[/url].
[*] [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1Ilm51RbW5BRkh4teT1VDB5g5HUVUyfnynNy2n_hf_9w?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Reincarnate[/url] as 6 different playable [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1X65ZDtBORTWHJdR7eFNAeeUhYBsRSylN?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Avatars[/url]:

[olist]
[*][url=https://youneedawiki.com/app/page/13nXOtpvoyk7hZKDQCeP0yVyLSgJgpzlvIDj8LoCpAKg?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Asura[/url] - [i]Anger [/i]- Wrathful demi-gods known for their fiery tempers and prowess in battle. Imposing and impassioned. Righteous fury incarnate, the multi-armed Asura grows more powerful as their being diminishes.
[*][url=https://youneedawiki.com/app/page/1fF3-a319LiBIyu8oJzhc-YVYxBIf1VwHaFuUv9Dn7og?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Deva[/url] - [i]Rapture [/i]- Pristine, deific beings residing in the heavens atop Mt Meru. Those who distinguish themselves with acts of mercy and kindness are reborn as the Deva, who glide lightly through the air and boast a deep well of magical power.
[*][url=https://youneedawiki.com/app/page/177k8XAxUa0EuoyhczVUsdtnOEDFPv6OcDvWy18-HsI0?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Tiryag[/url] - [i]Animality [/i]- Bestial warriors, fuelled by their instincts. Using their finely honed animal instincts for survival helps them sense unseen foes. Their heightened senses slow their perception of time in conflict, at the cost of being blinded by their single-minded mental state of stupidity and prejudice.
[*][url=https://youneedawiki.com/app/page/12Nq-YJpPDh-HSPsq99X-a2cCWm-l73zgzzsAjTmiC_Y?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Preta[/url] - [i]Hunger [/i]- A hungry ghost. Avarice manifest. A sorry fate. Forever hungry, even in places of abundance. Their being is gradually drained as their hunger is never truly sated. Their greed requires them to sustain their life at the expense of others, and they find treasures most would miss.
[*][url=https://youneedawiki.com/app/page/1iBYs85hRn9bqEtdrb0o2eHgMIg37AgR5z_MVLkjZEk8?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Manusya[/url] - [i]Desire, doubt, passion, pride and above all hope[/i] - Symbolic of hope and closest to karmic harmony. To be a human is to stand at the hub of fate’s wheel. Those whose karma has not yet pulled them far from where they began will take on this balanced form.
[*][url=https://youneedawiki.com/app/page/1EGVkpjBKNeonukdpIL-ZUs7018g4NwRCOfWl89qQxA0?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Naraka[/url] - [i]Hell [/i]- Vindictive, devious punishers. Those who walk a path of violence or ill-will are attuned to and revel in punishment and suffering. Hellish beings wielding fearsome and potent combat abilities that allow them to obliterate foes even at a distance.
[/olist]
[*]Various enemies, weapons, spells, accessories and offhand implements to find throughout your journey.
[/list]

[h2]What is the roadmap for Samsara updates?[/h2]
[b]February 2025[/b] - Uttarakuru Update
[list]
[*]Fourth continent: [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1NYiCSVg4c8qt2Bikej5GEO5_rFsgK3RSLi_BTcSW0TE?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Uttarakuru[/url], in the North of [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1O8-godtQWFXUcKdvWCDwqYLZNjbBkyNm?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Khamadhatu[/url].
[*]New boss at the end of Viratdeha: [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1Xn0GAQoqFjuZn14IQcqNTUIxm36xNT4_es0WvQYUcyg?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Khyati[/url], the fallen but proud Deva.
[*]Revamped [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1HrdqzTMaf7n1XRXkImoxOOjPOVcfSNifLLFUw-WapR0?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Meditation Menu[/url].
[*]Improvements to the [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1F-VbiANibP9w6Hpn4QHm_MgzGL_agrUA?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Exploration[/url] systems.
[*]New enemies, weapons, spells, accessories and offhand implements.
[/list]

[b]April 2025[/b] - World Progression Update
[list]
[*]New boss at the end of Aparagodaniya: fought in pursuit of the enigmatic [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1Sf_hcsKhKxrRfPww8YCW6Nob3rdldiFGYMlJZCRjRfE?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Kamadhenu[/url], a [i]"wish-granting cow"[/i].
[*]Improvements to the [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1t4evU-Ukz2brmbjxPbM4rl4vJMjl18SQ?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Combat[/url] systems.
[*]Additional content TBC.
[/list]

[b]June 2025[/b] - Samsara: Rebirth Release
[list]
[*]1.0 release on Steam and Epic Games Store.
[*]Face the "Lord of Death": [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1aSdTk-jrsi5IsLOs4RutKgo2Z3mkF2lKNYVBbyroBWY?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Yama[/url], the embodiment of impermanence and judge of ones past life and actions.
[*]Experience additional questlines and complete the story ("Escape Samsara") in the final update to the base game.
[*]Improvements to the [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1E_ak4fn4TYOIDcBD2ZfAwxnVASemHCOm?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Discourse[/url] systems.
[*]PROTOGÉ Mode added: see contributions from aspiring game developers who trained at INFINITY27, an Unreal Authorised Training Center.
[/list]

[h2]Are there any post-release updates planned?[/h2]
Yes. We have plans to continue to support the game with content updates but we wish to share them closer to the 1.0 release date. Games take time and we don't wish to overpromise at this stage.

The Uttarakuru Release is available to all Playtester Avatars from [b]2PM to 8PM on 13TH FEB.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958738/1ecfb6ea29898be5a38eaef7b412b55d2d1db9f1.png[/img]
